newsitem.title: UK: GUS shares gain as SBC Warburg upgrades.
newsitem.headline: GUS shares gain as SBC Warburg upgrades.

text.p: Shares in Great Universal Stores Plc rose on Monday, defying the market's general weakness as analysts at SBC Warburg raised the stock to "hold" from "reduce."
Shares in the retail group were up 8p at 634-1/2 by 0804 GMT, even as the FTSE 100 traded down 32.9 points at 4,237.8 -- with GUS one of only three stocks showing an advance.

Sources said SBC Warburg took a positive view of GUS's acquisition of U.S. marketing information services company Direct Marketing Technology Inc, for up to $301 million including the target company's debt.
Analysts at the brokerage also highlighted the fact that GUS shares had dropped to a 4-1/2-year relative low against the FTSE 100 index.
Analysts at Warburg were not immediately available for comment.
